limitations: Assembly coverage and all admitted labels are reused as originally verified; this build does not re-run the original verifiers.
Ticker/name-only matches can be wrong for reused tickers or renamed issuers.
The candidate ledger was generated from SEC form signals through its own date range and is not an exhaustive event census.
Vendor symbol mapping (asof) is not CIK identity or historical membership.
Outcome-exposed retrospective collection; no predictive or independent confirmation.

semantics.candidates: Unadjudicated SEC form signals (tender-offer target / merger-proxy filer) from the 336-row candidate ledger; not labels. Absence of a candidate is not evidence of no event.
semantics.identity: CIK only from the assembly join to reviewed original financial records; ticker or name matches are flagged unverified and never resolve identity.
semantics.negatives: This ledger assigns no labels. Only the 20 existing structurally admitted rows carry binary outcomes.
semantics.source_availability: Existing artifact presence only; queues and collections remain pending substantive review unless an assembly-verified corpus hash is present.
semantics.valuation: Vendor SIP raw daily bars for the 15 days before cutoff show quote availability under a current-vendor reconstruction only; original_vendor_vintage_archived false; no valuation rating is supported.
